courses.title: Applied GenAI & Full-Stack System Architecture
courses.shortDescription: Build production-ready agentic AI systems, RAG pipelines with Vector DBs, Gemini 2.5 Flash, React 19, TypeScript, and auto-scaling microservices on Kubernetes.
courses.fullDescription: An intensive, hands-on 12-week professional program engineered for software developers wanting to bridge modern React/Node architecture with state-of-the-art Generative AI. You will build enterprise RAG pipelines, deploy real-time multi-agent systems, optimize LLM context caching, and deploy auto-scaling microservices on Google Cloud Run and Kubernetes.

instructor.name: Dr. Aravind Sundararajan
instructor.title: Principal AI Architect & Ex-Google Staff Engineer
instructor.bio: Over 14 years building planetary-scale AI systems and leading production ML infra teams across Silicon Valley and Bengaluru.

modules.title: Foundations of Modern Distributed Web Architecture
Deep Dive: LLM Integrations & Agentic Frameworks

learningOutcomes: Architect production-ready full-stack applications with bulletproof type safety.
Deploy autonomous AI agents with function calling and vector-backed search.
Optimize database queries and connection pooling for 10k+ concurrent users.
requirements: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React basics.

faq.question: Are live sessions recorded?
faq.answer: Yes, 4K recordings with code repositories are provided after every workshop.

courses.title: Digital Product Design & Enterprise Design Systems
courses.shortDescription: Master user research heuristics, interactive Figma prototyping, multi-brand tokenized design systems, accessibility math, and design-to-code handoffs.
courses.fullDescription: Craft intuitive, world-class user experiences for complex software products. Learn UX research heuristics, rapid prototyping, building tokenized multi-brand design systems in Figma, and collaborating seamlessly with frontend engineering teams.

instructor.name: Tanya Roy
instructor.title: Lead Product Designer & Design Systems Advocate
instructor.bio: Design systems consultant and international design juror with expertise in tokenized multi-brand UI design.

learningOutcomes: Create multi-platform design systems with scalable design tokens.
Produce polished case studies ready for product designer interviews at top startups.
requirements: Curiosity and a computer with access to Figma.

faq.question: Is prior design experience required?
faq.answer: No prior experience is necessary; we start from first principles.

courses.title: Advanced Cyber Defense & Practical Ethical Hacking
courses.shortDescription: Master web application security (OWASP Top 10), network penetration testing, API vulnerability exploitation, and DevSecOps safeguards.
courses.fullDescription: Comprehensive training in modern cybersecurity defense and ethical penetration testing. Learn how attackers think, how to audit codebases for zero-day flaws, how to secure cloud environments, and how to build automated security gates in CI/CD pipelines.

instructor.name: Meera Nair, CISSP
instructor.title: Head of Information Security & Red Teamer
instructor.bio: Certified Red Team Operator with a decade of enterprise security audits for banking and telecom systems.

modules.title: Modern Threat Modeling & Web App Pen-Testing

learningOutcomes: Conduct end-to-end vulnerability assessments on web and API services.
Remediate high-severity OWASP vulnerabilities before production releases.
requirements: Basic understanding of networking, HTTP, and terminal commands.

faq.question: Is the lab environment safe and isolated?
faq.answer: Yes, all labs run on our dedicated, isolated Claxic Cyber Range.

courses.title: Cloud-Native DevOps & Kubernetes at Enterprise Scale
courses.shortDescription: Hands-on training in Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD GitOps, Helm, and Multi-Cloud Observability on AWS & GCP.
courses.fullDescription: Master the core infrastructure stack powering world-class tech companies. From containerizing legacy services to deploying zero-downtime blue-green Canary releases with Kubernetes and Service Meshes (Istio), this program equips you with industry-tested DevOps engineering competencies.

instructor.name: Rohan Kapoor
instructor.title: Principal Infrastructure Architect
instructor.bio: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Fellow with 11+ years managing 500+ node multi-region clusters.

learningOutcomes: Operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters on GCP and AWS.
Automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and ArgoCD.
requirements: Basic Linux command line and Git familiarity.

faq.question: Do I need paid cloud accounts?
faq.answer: No, all sandbox cloud accounts are included for the labs.

courses.title: Distributed System Design & High-Concurrency Architecture
courses.shortDescription: Master the architectural patterns used by Netflix, Uber, and Google: Sharding, Consistent Hashing, Event-Driven Architecture, and Resiliency.
courses.fullDescription: Designed specifically for mid-level and senior engineers targeting Staff Engineer roles. Learn how to design fault-tolerant systems handling millions of queries per second with sub-millisecond latency, distributed consensus (Raft/Paxos), and event-driven patterns.

instructor.name: Vikramaditya Singh
instructor.title: Distinguished Systems Architect
instructor.bio: Former lead architect behind high-concurrency real-time payment switches handling 100k+ transactions/second.

learningOutcomes: Design reliable distributed systems scaling to millions of queries per second.
Lead Staff and Principal Engineering system design interviews with confidence.
requirements: At least 2 years of software engineering experience.

faq.question: Are 1-on-1 mock interviews included?
faq.answer: Yes, every enrolled student receives a private 45-minute live mock session.

courses.title: Modern Data Science, Deep Learning & MLOps
courses.shortDescription: Master statistical machine learning, PyTorch deep learning, feature engineering, model registry, and MLOps deployment pipelines.
courses.fullDescription: Become an industry-ready Data Scientist capable of translating messy raw business datasets into accurate, operational machine learning models with PyTorch, XGBoost, MLflow, and FastAPI serving.

instructor.name: Dr. Samir Bose
instructor.title: Chief Data Scientist
instructor.bio: PhD in Statistical Learning from Carnegie Mellon with 20+ peer-reviewed ML papers and patents.

learningOutcomes: Build and evaluate complex statistical machine learning models.
Deploy production inference endpoints with automated drift monitoring.
requirements: Python programming fundamentals and basic math.

faq.question: Are GPU instances provided for deep learning labs?
faq.answer: Yes, GPU cloud instances are provided for PyTorch model training.

formData.statementOfIntent: Focusing my final year capstone on production LLM agents and multi-agent microservices.
